incidents.summary: Israel's environmental ministry fined Energean NIS 878,000 for a Karish drilling permit violation involving cement dumped into the sea.

sources.title: Energean fined for Karish drilling violation - Globes
sources.quote: Israel's Ministry of Environmental Protection has fined Energean Oil & Gas plc (LSE: ENOG; TASE: ENOG) NIS 878,000 for violating the terms of its permit

sources.title: Energean fined for Karish drilling violation - Globes
sources.quote: The drilling ship violated the instruction of the permit for gas flow from the sea and during its routine operations dumped cement into the sea.

sources.title: Energean fined for Karish drilling violation - Globes
sources.quote: We respect the decision of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and will work accordingly.

incidents.summary: A union solidarity statement alleged that Energean's Kavala restructuring led to all 185 plant workers being dismissed, while a 2024 report said the court acquitted 136 workers of all charges in the associated dispute.

sources.title: Solidarity with the Workers at Kavala Oil | ecology.iww.org
sources.quote: In April 2021, Energean announced a unilateral restructuring program which in mass layoffs with the intention to replacing highly skilled and experienced permanent workers with unskilled contract workers.

sources.title: Solidarity with the Workers at Kavala Oil | ecology.iww.org
sources.quote: Despite the incredible effort of the union workers, the layoffs have continued and all 185 workers at the plant have now been dismissed, leaving the facility unstaffed.

sources.title: Αθωώθηκαν οι περισσότεροι από τις χαλκευμένες κατηγορίες της εργοδοσίας | ΕΡΓΑΤΙΚΑ | ΡΙΖΟΣΠΑΣΤΗΣ
sources.quote: Το Τριμελές Πλημμελειοδικείο Kαβάλας ομόφωνα αθώωσε τους 136 εργαζόμενους και για τις 11 κατηγορίες για τις οποίες διώκονταν.

incidents.summary: A union solidarity statement reported an explosion and tank fire at Kavala Oil on 9 April 2022 that took more than five hours to extinguish, with no injuries.

sources.title: Solidarity with the Workers at Kavala Oil | ecology.iww.org
sources.quote: On Saturday the 9th of April 2022, an explosion occurred, and a large fire broke out in a tank of the Kavala Oil facilities, which contained water and residues of oils and petroleum products.

sources.title: Solidarity with the Workers at Kavala Oil | ecology.iww.org
sources.quote: It took the firefighters more than 5 hours to extinguish the fire.

sources.title: Solidarity with the Workers at Kavala Oil | ecology.iww.org
sources.quote: The facility was not in operation and fortunately there were no injuries.
